field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: Missouri economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: Missouri does not have a transaction count threshold

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: Missouri uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: Missouri corporate income tax rate: 4.0% flat rate - MO Rev. Stat. § 143.071

field.name: mo_federal_tax_deduction_percentage
field.comment: Missouri allows deduction of 50% of federal income tax paid - MO Rev. Stat. § 143.121

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: Missouri additions: federal interest income, certain expenses, IRC 199A addback, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: Missouri subtractions: 50% federal tax deduction, MO municipal interest, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: Missouri tax credits: jobs creation, historic preservation, film production, etc.
